Three things the code does that the tables do not suggest
HalveSaveDamageA (0DE8:0F98) asks RollMemberSave for 0 or 1 and then tests d20 >= that, which always holds: a party member always takes
half from a save-for-half effect.
The same test makes DamageOneMember's save (1 >> 1 = 0) fail every time: the first eligible member is hit for 100.
RollMemberSave looks written to give a Constitution bonus to dwarves, halflings and gnomes (AD&D's rule) [I]; it tests race * 2 against 3, 5 and
4, so the bonus goes only to male elves (race index 2).
